adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when credential sync is enabled it POSTs to `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` with only `calcomUserId` and `appSlug` in the body and no auth material (no shared secret header, signature, etc.). The diff also shows an inbound webhook (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`) that *does* enforce a shared secret header, highlighting that a shared secret mechanism exists but is not used for the outbound token-refresh call. If the sync endpoint is reachable and implemented to return refreshed access tokens based on those two fields, there is nothing in this client request that lets the receiver authenticate/authorize the caller, making it possible to request tokens for arbitrary user IDs by calling the endpoint directly.
